_about: L2 day-division tables. Weekday index 0 = Sunday. Segment indices are 1-based. Every table carries a source id from research/02-vedic-knowledge.md (section) with its confidence tag, or UNVERIFIED.

eighths.source: research/02 §2.6.1 [S] hindutone + dekhopanchang; Phaladeepika ch. 25 via Wikipedia Upagraha (Gulika = Saturn's eighth, Yamaganda = Jupiter's)

choghadiya.source: research/02 §2.6.5 [P] Drik Panchang choghadiya tutorial: day = +1 steps through the sequence starting at dayStart[weekday]; night = starts at dayStart+5 and steps -2 (Sun night Shubh, Amrit, Char, Rog, Kaal, Labh, Udveg, Shubh), both reproduced in test/kala.test.ts for all 7 weekdays

muhurtas.source: research/02 §2.6.4 [S] Wikipedia Muhurta + dekhopanchang; quality conflicts (10, 15, 22) Raman vs dekho marked 'conflict'; Abhijit not on Wednesday [S] §2.6.2

durmuhurta.source: research/02 §2.6.4 [P-via-Raman] Muhurta Chintamani dosha #7/#13 (jyotishkalpadrum); matches Drik Panchang 'Dur Muhurtam' windows on 2026-10-20 (Tue, 4th) and 2027-01-14 (Thu, 6th and 12th); Monday 9th [S1]

brahmaMuhurta.rule: 29th of 30 muhurtas: nextSunrise - 2 night-muhurtas to nextSunrise - 1 night-muhurta

pradosha.source: research/02 §2.6.8 [CONFLICT] Nirnayasindhu 3 ghati vs digests 6 ghati; Drik uses sunset + 2h24m for Dhanteras/Diwali Lakshmi puja [M]

varjyam.source: research/02 §2.6.7 [P] Drik nakshatra-thyajyam table (Tamil column, 1-based: value 51 means 50 ghatis elapsed; verified on Chennai 2026-11-08 Swati). Amrit kaal = Varjyam start + 24 ghatis: matches Drik for Swati, and the Prashnamarga column for Bharani/Krittika, but not Rohini (52) - UNVERIFIED for other nakshatras

sandhya.source: research/02 §2.6.9 [M] Dharmasindhu sandhya kaalas avoided for beginnings
